result.reason: The redline appropriately limits TrueLink’s licence to service delivery and confirms Client ownership of Credit Data. However, it does not fully reach either playbook position: stating that Client “retains” ownership of Support Services results does not affirmatively assign Vendor-created deliverables or work product, and there is no treatment of Vendor pre-existing IP, no perpetual licence to Vendor IP embedded in deliverables, and no fallback licence permitting use, modification and sublicensing of deliverables. It also does not expressly preclude joint ownership. The changes are otherwise targeted and preserve TrueLink’s ability to use the data to provide the services, but the deliverables language needs operative assignment or licence terms.
